description_en: Queries the scheduler settings of a cluster
description_zh: 调用GetSchedulerInfo查询指定集群的调度信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc get-scheduler-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --scheduler SchedName=pbs --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSchedulerInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

element_fields.help_en:
The scheduler name. Valid values:

*   pbs
*   pbs19
*   slurm
*   slurm19
*   slurm20

Valid values of N: 0 to 100
element_fields.help_zh:
调度器名称。取值范围：

- pbs
- pbs19
- slurm
- slurm19
- slurm20
element_fields.name: sched_name

parameters.help_en: The detailed settings of the scheduler
parameters.name: scheduler
